name: LeadGen AI - Phase 4 Lead Capture Pipeline

nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers on newly appended row in linked Google Form response spreadsheet. Do not hardcode credentials.

nodes.name: Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes: Trims whitespace, normalizes email to lowercase, and preserves spreadsheet row number

nodes.name: Check Duplicate in FastAPI
nodes.notes: Queries FastAPI database to verify if email already exists

nodes.name: FastAPI Ingestion (lead-capture)
nodes.notes: Submits validated lead to FastAPI SQLite database without triggering emails

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Success)
nodes.notes: Updates spreadsheet row with Processing status and Lead ID

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Duplicate)
nodes.notes: Marks duplicate row to prevent duplicate lead processing

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Invalid)
nodes.notes: Logs validation failure reasons to spreadsheet for manual correction
